## About
Rodriguez Auto Glass is a family owned and operated shop on San Fernando Rd, run by Rodrigo, a true car care professional. We repair auto glass, replace windshields and fix power windows, and we also offer local mobile service.
Our motto is simple: treat every customer the way they would want to be treated. That is how we keep our neighbors coming back whenever they need glass repaired or replaced. We speak Spanish, and we stand behind our work.
Customers rate us 4.7 on Google from 121 reviews.

## Services
- Auto glass repair: Repairs for your vehicle's glass, handled with care and focus on quality work.
- Windshield replacement: Cracked or damaged windshield replaced. A reviewer who came in with a bad crack said the new windshield is very clear.
- Power window repairs: Windows that are stuck, jammed or won't go all the way up, fixed by people with the skills to get it done right.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and we'll give you a free estimate.

Q: Is your work guaranteed?
A: Yes. All of our work is guaranteed, including auto glass repairs, windshield replacements and power window repairs.

Q: Do you offer mobile service?
A: Yes. We provide local mobile services for your convenience.

Q: Do you speak Spanish?
A: Yes, we speak Spanish.
